title: Tengyue (Olivia) Zhang
text:
PhD Student in Bioengineering · UCLA
I study multimodal learning, generative models, and computational pathology in the Hsu Lab at UCLA. My research explores how machine learning can integrate medical data and generalize across imaging domains.

title: Tengyue (Olivia) Zhang

Research interests

Multimodal learning for medical data
Generative models and domain adaptation
